result.description:
Our Client is looking for part-time and full-time provisional and general psychologists to join their high performance, private, multi-disciplinary clinics on a minimum of 90k per year full time salary (up to 150k+ dependent on experience and skills).  

   

  About The Company:  

 They are an award-winning business that started in 2016 that operates large multidisciplinary clinics found on Brisbane’s Southside in Slacks Creek & Eight Mile Plains. 

 Each location has a team of 15-20 full time clinicians and 3-4 full time administrators including: physiotherapists, exercise physiologists, dietitians, diabetic educators, massage therapists, psychologists, occupational therapists and specialist visiting doctors. 

 Their psychology team has become recognized for their success with complex, chronic and lifelong conditions.  

 The typical weekly client caseload for  new  psychologists is highly varied including trauma (30%-40%), depression and anxiety (30-40%), pediatrics i.e. eating disorders, ASD / ADHD (20-30%) and a scattering of other conditions (10%) such as performance mindset and chronic pain.  

   

  Why them?  

 
	 Large multi-disciplinary teams for patient care 
	 Transparent markers to get your salary up to 150k+ or higher  
	 Flexible working hours 
	 Discount Services for Family members  at Champion Health.  
	  Unlimited  individual professional development funding 
	 Regular Team Events & Activities 
	 Large Gym on site for clinician usage and patient treatment 
	 Weekly paid meetings; MDT conference, intra-disciplinary meeting, 1 on 1 mentoring and PD meeting  
	 10 Year Career pathways:
	 
		 Academic / Mentoring
		 
			 Be trained as a subject matter expert or mentor other clinicians  
			 Move into a profit share position by learning and developing business skills and becoming a clinical lead.  
			 Receive financial and study support while you pursue further specialization or a different degree. 
		 
		 
		 Business / Leadership
		 
			 Transition to non-clinical specialised health roles 
			 Move into a profit share position by learning and developing business skills and becoming a business development lead.  
		 
		 
	 
	 
 

  Who are we looking for?  

 
	 Genuine want to be challenged and grow.  
	 Interest in being a part of a team to optimise patient results for the long term.  
	 Desire to have a big impact in the local and wider communities 
	 Holding clinical and personal interests to EXCELLENT standards and don’t want to settle for ‘average’.  
	 Transparency in communication and loyalty i.e. win / win situations.  
 
 
 
   Apply Now
